biography.value: Void Shades introduce life drain as a sustained battlefield effect rather than a single-hit consequence. The Life Drain Aura erodes maximum HP from everything nearby every round, creating a timer that forces enemies to either engage the Void Shade directly or retreat from its proximity. Darkness Shroud combined with the Void Shade's ability to see through it creates a zone where it fights at full effectiveness against Blinded opponents. Shadow Form at DR 10 in darkness makes conventional weapons nearly useless against it while the darkness is active. A summoner who establishes dim or dark conditions before calling a Void Shade will find it functions at a tier above its rating. One who calls it into a brightly lit environment will find it still capable but operating at a disadvantage it will attempt to remedy by moving toward whatever shadow is available.

system.sensesNotes: Darkvision 120 ft, Devil's Sight, See Invisibility, Perfect Sight 30 ft
system.attacksNotes:
Void Touch [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 8 + Melee Combat 6), Reach: 10 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 12 damage (7 + 5 Str) + 4 Negative damage (Ignore DR); target loses 4 from Current Luck; target's maximum HP reduced by 8 until long rest (life drain).
  • Margin 2: 12 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 Negative damage; Current Luck reduced by 5; max HP reduced by 12; target Weakened + Sickened for 1 minute; no save.
  • Margin 3: 12 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 Negative damage; Current Luck reduced by 6; max HP reduced by 16; Weakened + Sickened; target makes Fortitude [Easy] save or gains 1 Exhaustion level.

Shadow Tendril [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 3 + Ranged Combat 5), Range: 60 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 15 Negative damage (12 + 3 Dex); target loses 3 from Current Luck; max HP reduced by 6.
  • Margin 2: 15 Negative damage, DR halved (round up); Current Luck reduced by 4; max HP reduced by 10; Weakened for 1 minute; no save.
  • Margin 3: 15 Negative damage, DR halved (round up); Current Luck reduced by 5; max HP reduced by 14; Weakened + Disoriented for 1 minute; no save.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Shadow Form: While in dim light or darkness, DR increases to 10 against all non-magical damage and non-Positive energy damage. Positive energy ignores this entirely. Life Drain Aura: Creatures within 10 feet that are not Shadow creatures lose 2 from their maximum HP at the start of each of their turns. This maximum HP loss persists until long rest. A creature reduced to 0 maximum HP by this aura dies. Darkness Shroud (1/encounter) [Combat]: As a [Combat] action, creates a 30-foot diameter of magical darkness centered on itself. This darkness persists for 1 minute and moves with the Void Shade. The Void Shade sees through it normally. Other Shadow creatures see through it. Planar Step (3/short rest): As a [Move] action, steps briefly into the Shadow Plane and re-emerges up to 30 feet away in any dim or dark location it can see. Does not provoke opportunity ### Attacks. Cannot be used in bright light. Resilient Defense (2/day): When the Void Shade fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
